chapter: Central High, first records and leaving home
title: Rockwell wants her on tour, her mother insists she finish school
summary: Rockwell wanted to send her on tour but her mother said she would finish school first. Humes had no wish to travel after hearing how musicians were treated, and the family and the little band were proud of her records.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: A terrible shame. Well listen, so what happened now - let's go back to Tommy Rockwell. Did he want to sign you up or what happened?

Yeah. He said he wanted me to go on a tour and Mama said, 'she's not going on no tour or nothing because she's going to finish school. After she finishes school, whatever she wants to do, she can do it'.
And you didn't mind did you?
No. I didn't know anything about traveling. And I didn't want to be traveling no how because I'd hear them talk about the way they were treated and everything.
Yeah. What about when the records came out? How did everybody at home react to that?
Oh well, you know, they all said, 'you ought to do, you ought to go'.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Well what about the little Band? They must have been proud of you, weren't they?
Yeah, they were. They were proud of me. But we were still in High School.
